name: DLUSD
who_can_redeem: Eligible Deel contractors can move DLUSD stablecoin-wallet balances back to their Deel balance for USD value; exact direct Bridge redemption eligibility is not established in the reviewed sources.
redemption_region_notes: Stablecoin-wallet availability varies by country and requires Deel eligibility/KYC; Bridge direct-purchaser rules are separate.
redemption_notes: Deel describes DLUSD as a USD-denominated digital balance designed to track USD value 1:1 and always redeemable for USD value within the platform. This record does not infer a direct legal redemption claim against Bridge beyond the reviewed sources.
summary: USD-denominated custom stablecoin used in Deel's contractor stablecoin wallet, issued through Bridge Open Issuance and settled on Tempo.
notes: Stripe announced the DLUSD launch on 2026-06-03 and Deel now reports the stablecoin wallet live in 80+ countries. Exact token contract, issuing affiliate, current reserve allocation and direct issuer-redemption boundary remain explicit unknowns.
